name: logo-design
description: One designer explores directions with an image model, you pick a direction at a gate, the designer vectors it into original SVG concepts, an independent judge scores them, and the conductor runs revision rounds. Scope, deliverables, provider chains, and image model are chosen at launch. For ByteDesk brand work prefer the design-studio template, which drives the design-system repo’s own design-system-studio roles; this one is the generic pipeline for repos without a studio.

agents.instructions: Scope: {{inputs.scope}} (product: {{inputs.product}}). Deliverables requested: {{inputs.deliverables}}. Write the brief with brand-brief; for scope=family the brief covers every profile in profiles/ and asks for one construction system, for scope=master it covers DESIGN.md §3 and the family accent table instead of one profile. Stage `explore` runs only when image_skill is not `none` ({{inputs.image_skill}}); after it, stop at the `pick-direction` gate and show the operator the contact sheet the designer produced, then pass the chosen direction id into the concepts brief. After the judge accepts, stop at the final gate; only then send the `deliverables` stage, listing exactly the deliverables requested and nothing more. Never promote into assets/ or catalog.json yourself.

You explore with images first and vector second. In the explore stage, use the {{inputs.image_skill}} skill to generate {{inputs.directions}} directions × 2 images into artifacts/designer/<message-id>/directions/<n>/ and a CONTACT-SHEET.md as brand-explore describes; images are mood references only and are never deliverables. In the concepts stage, produce {{inputs.concepts}} original SVG concepts from the chosen direction per brand-concept. If the image skill is `none`, skip exploration and say so in your reply.
Score with the brand-judge rubric against the brief and the governing profile(s). Disqualify any concept that reproduces a generated mood image literally or violates a ban.

workflow.description: Conductor writes the brief for the chosen scope with brand-brief and includes the deliverables list and the image_skill choice.
Designer generates direction images with the image skill and writes a contact sheet with one paragraph per direction. Skipped when image_skill=none.
Human gate: operator chooses a direction id (or asks for more exploration).
Designer vectors the chosen direction into original SVG concepts with mono and reverse variants and small-size checks.
Judge scores every concept and returns one verdict.
Only the named concept is revised with the judge's numbered fixes, then back to judge.
After the final gate: designer produces exactly the requested deliverable set from the accepted mark (lockup, favicon, app icons, social) under artifacts/designer/final/.

gates.description: Pick the direction to vector from the contact sheet.
Approve the accepted concept before deliverables are produced and before any promotion into assets/.

artifacts.promote_to: Use the design-system-assets skill to import artifacts/designer/final/ into assets/products/<product>/ (or assets/brand/ for scope=master) with catalog provenance; keep directions/, every concept round, and the scorecards under artifacts/ as the decision trail DESIGN.md §7 requires.
